scope: Nineteen actual native loops, one generic plus eighteen width-specialized. Each static path assumes funded productive traversal, first fingerprint/full-key hit and nonnull present entry. Paths are not assigned a source width from layout order, and are not dynamic frequencies or cycle estimates.
finding: The static paths retain 48–51 instructions and six branches, compared with the retained IR65 path of 55/six/zero stack accesses and protected Rust path of 34/four/two. Constant-width cloning alone does not reach the Rust instruction structure.
